newsitem.title: USA: Jefferson Savings closes Texas Heritage purchase.
newsitem.headline: Jefferson Savings closes Texas Heritage purchase.

text.p: Jefferson Savings Bancorp Inc said Thursday it completed its acquisition of Texas Heritage Savings Association/Banc for an undisclosed amount of cash and stock.
Texas Heritage will be consolidated into Jefferson Savings' current thrift charter and operate under name First Federal Savings Bank of North Texas, the new owner said.
Jefferson Savings also expects its pending purchase of L&B Financial Inc to close in the first quarter of 1997.
Jefferson Savings is a thrift holding company. Its stock closed unchanged Thursday at 26.
